name: The Defias Traitor
summary: At Sentinel Hill, The Defias Traitor has revealed the Brotherhood's hidden base to spare his life. The People's Militia caught him stealing Farmer Saldean's wagon and now holds him beneath the watchtower.

sections.title: Leading the Way to Moonbrook
sections.body: Under guard at Sentinel Hill's watchtower, the traitor must lead Alliance champions through hostile country to the hidden entrance beneath ruined Moonbrook. His former comrades hate him, and his captors despise him. Yet his betrayal gives the People's Militia a chance to strike at the Brotherhood's heart.

sections.title: A Bargain for Survival
sections.body: The Defias Brotherhood does not command every member's loyalty to Edwin VanCleef. Gryan Stoutmantle's militia caught the petty thief trying to steal Farmer Saldean's wagon. Facing execution, he chose to save himself. He revealed the hidden base's exact location in exchange for his life.

aliases: who is the traitor at sentinel hill
faq.answer: The Defias Traitor once belonged to the Brotherhood. The People's Militia caught him trying to steal Farmer Saldean's wagon, and he agreed to lead Militia allies to the hidden lair to escape execution.

faq.q: Why is he standing outside the tower in Sentinel Hill?
aliases: why is he at sentinel hill
faq.answer: Gryan Stoutmantle and the People's Militia hold him outside their stronghold under armed guard. He remains there until volunteers escort him to the Defias hideout.
He leads travelers southwest across Westfall's plains to the derelict town of Moonbrook. There, he points out the concealed entrance to the Defias Hideout.

faq.q: Why did he turn against the Defias Brotherhood?
faq.answer: He turned against the Brotherhood to save himself. Caught stealing from Farmer Saldean and facing execution, he offered its greatest secret in exchange for his life.

angles.text: For the People's Militia and Westfall's defenders, this prisoner marks a turning point in their struggle against the outlaws terrorizing the region.
As a Rogue, you know how fragile loyalty can be among criminals. Cornered by the law, thieves and cutpurses may sell out their own.
